title: Getting Claude to code you a lab for tuning soulslike combat parameters
author: Potential_Ad_7544
selftext:
Just discovered something super handy for me so thought I'd share in case useful for anyone else.

I'm messing around with concepts for soulslike games - the "souls bandicoot" was a kind of dumb but maybe (?) fun idea like "what if crash bandicoot but souls" - and wanted to test out combat systems with mobile controls.

Given how finely tuned and frame-sensitive good soulslike combat is, I found myself wanting to tweak lots of parameters in different combinations. Opus 5 was fantastic at setting this up as a sandbox to help visualise hitboxes and impacts of different changes, as well as running a bunch of tests in different scenarios.

This is all running three.js and Opus is creating all the assets itself within the JavaScript, no external files.

Happy to share prompts and summary stuff for recreating if helpful
